title: QueryResult
description: QueryResult: Represents the result of a SQLite query operation including data, metadata, and execution information.

Data.description: The data rows returned by the query. Each row is represented as a dictionary of column name to value.

ColumnNames.description: The column names in the result set in order.

RowCount.description: The number of rows returned in the result set.

AffectedRows.description: The number of rows affected by the query (for INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE operations).

ExecutionTime.description: The time taken to execute the query. Returned in milliseconds but converted as per BHoM conventions. Property has a quantity of type Time measured in [s].

ExecutedQuery.description: The SQL query that was executed.

ErrorMessage.description: Error message if the query failed.

IsCached.description: Whether this result was cached or came directly from the database.

Metadata.description: Additional metadata about the query execution.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
